BAI.name: B.Tech Artificial Intelligence
BAI.description: Complete semester study pack for B.Tech AI students at VIT Bhopal. Covers OOP with C++, Data Structures & Algorithms, Linear Algebra, Probability & Statistics, OS, DBMS, Python Programming, Data Science, Computational Physics, and Digital Forensics.

BCE.name: B.Tech Computer Engineering
BCE.description: Complete semester study pack for B.Tech CE students at VIT Bhopal. Covers OOP with C++, Data Structures, Java, AI/ML Fundamentals, DBMS, Digital Logic Design, Engineering Design, Computer Architecture, and Applied Linear Algebra.

BCG.name: B.Tech CS (Game Development)
BCG.description: Complete semester study pack for B.Tech CG students at VIT Bhopal. Covers Unity Game Programming, Physics of Game Dev, Data Structures, OS, Design & Analysis of Algorithms, Linear Algebra, Digital Logic Design, and Professional Communication.

BEY.name: B.Tech ECY
BEY.description: Complete semester study pack for B.Tech ECY students at VIT Bhopal. Covers Digital Logic Design, Signals & Systems, Data Structures, Java Programming, DBMS, Applied Numerical Methods, Environmental Sustainability, Electric Circuits, and Microprocessors.

BSA.name: B.Tech Computational Sciences
BSA.description: Complete semester study pack for B.Tech SA students at VIT Bhopal. Covers Discrete Mathematics, Cloud Architecture, OS, Data Structures & Algorithms, Professional Communication, Foundations of Data Science, and DBMS.

MIM.name: M.Tech Integrated Management
MIM.description: Complete semester study pack for M.Tech IM students at VIT Bhopal. Covers Discrete Mathematics, Data Structures, AI/ML Fundamentals, Professional Communication, Principles of Management, Technology Entrepreneurship, and Design & Analysis of Algorithms.
